question: How many customers are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer

question: List the names of all genres in alphabetical order.
sql: SELECT Name FROM Genre ORDER BY Name

question: Which country has the most customers? Show the country and the number of customers.
sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY customers DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total revenue across all invoices?
sql: SELECT SUM(Total) AS total_revenue FROM Invoice

question: Which artists have more than 10 albums? Show the artist name and the album count.
sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS albums FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId HAVING COUNT(al.AlbumId) > 10

question: How many tracks are in the Rock genre?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rock_tracks FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock'

question: Which customers are from Brazil? Show first name, last name and email.
sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

question: How many invoices were issued in 2023?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoices_2023 FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2023'

question: What is the total invoice revenue per year? Show the year and the revenue.
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS year, SUM(Total) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

question: Which customer has spent the most in total? Show their first name, last name and total spent.
sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS total_spent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks are longer than 5 minutes?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS long_tracks FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 300000

question: Which media type has the most tracks? Show the media type name and the track count.
sql: SELECT m.Name, COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId ORDER BY tracks DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many albums does Iron Maiden have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS albums FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'Iron Maiden'

question: How many tracks are on the playlist called 'Brazilian Music'?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Playlist p ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Brazilian Music'

question: Which employee supports the most customers? Show the employee's first name, last name and the number of customers.
sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS customers FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY customers DESC LIMIT 1

question: For every employee who has a manager, show the employee's first name, last name and the manager's last name.
sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, m.LastName AS manager_last_name FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId

question: How many distinct billing countries appear on invoices?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BillingCountry) AS countries FROM Invoice

question: What is the average invoice total for invoices billed to Germany, rounded to two decimals?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS avg_total FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = 'Germany'

question: Which genre has the longest average track length? Show the genre name and the average length in milliseconds.
sql: SELECT g.Name, AVG(t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ms FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY avg_ms DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks does the artist AC/DC have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM Track t JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'

question: What is the total number of tracks sold, meaning the sum of quantities across all invoice lines?
sql: SELECT SUM(Quantity) AS tracks_sold FROM InvoiceLine

question: Which sales support agent generated the most invoice revenue? Show first name, last name and total revenue.
sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS revenue FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which cities have more than one customer? Show the city and the country.
sql: SELECT City, Country FROM Customer GROUP BY City, Country HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

question: How many tracks have no composer listed?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS no_composer FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NULL

question: What is the name of the longest track and how long is it in milliseconds?
sql: SELECT Name, Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers does each country have? Show the country and the count.
sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM Customer GROUP BY Country

question: What is the total amount invoiced to the customer with the email luisg@embraer.com.br?
sql: SELECT SUM(i.Total) AS total_invoiced FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.Email = 'luisg@embraer.com.br'

question: How many albums are in the database?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS album_count FROM Album

question: Which genres have more than 300 tracks? Show the genre name and the track count.
sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId HAVING COUNT(*) > 300

question: How many distinct tracks appear on more than one playlist?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS multi_playlist_tracks FROM (SELECT TrackId FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY TrackId HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
